fields.title: Form 10-K FY2026 (fiscal year ended Jan 25, 2026)
fields.summary: Primary source. FY2026 revenue $215.9B (+65.5% YoY); net income $120.1B; gross margin 71.1%, down from 75.0%; Data Center revenue $193.7B, about 90% of total, Gaming about 7%; two direct customers at 22% and 14% of revenue; revenue by customer headquarters: US $149.6B, China incl. Hong Kong $19.7B; a $4.5B charge in Q1 FY2026 tied to H20 export-licence requirements for China.

fields.title: Latest Form 10-Q and quarterly results release
fields.source: SEC Form 10-Q (most recent quarter on file)
fields.summary: Quarterly update reviewed against the annual filing for changes in segment mix, customer concentration language and risk factors; the annual figures in the snapshot remain the 10-K's.

fields.title: Q4 FY2026 earnings-call transcript
fields.summary: Management's own commentary, kept as a transcript so claims made on the call can be checked line by line against the filing. The transcript verifies what was said — not that what was said is true.

fields.title: Market capitalisation, about $5.0T (Nov 3, 2026)
fields.summary: A moving market figure from a third-party data page. Re-base on the IC-date close before any valuation work; do not carry this number into the IC memo as a fact. Third-party estimates put enterprise value at about $4.96T on the same date; the target's indicative-EV field carries that estimate, not the market-cap figure.
